import math
import unittest

from solution import simulate_zones


class SimulateZonesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.zones = [
            {"name": "a", "temperature": 0, "capacity": 2},
            {"name": "b", "temperature": 10, "capacity": 1},
        ]
        self.links = [["a", "b", 0.2]]
        self.targets = {"a": [2, 4], "b": [5, 7]}

    def test_simultaneous_conduction_control_and_copying(self):
        result = simulate_zones(iter(self.zones), self.links, self.targets, 2)
        self.assertEqual(result, [
            {"name": "a", "temperature": 2.5},
            {"name": "b", "temperature": 6.0},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(self.zones[0]["temperature"], 0)
        result[0]["temperature"] = 99
        self.assertEqual(self.zones[0]["temperature"], 0)

    def test_zero_steps_and_empty_system(self):
        self.assertEqual(simulate_zones(self.zones, self.links, self.targets, 0), [
            {"name": "a", "temperature": 0.0},
            {"name": "b", "temperature": 10.0},
        ])
        self.assertEqual(simulate_zones([], [], {}, 3), [])

    def test_type_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): simulate_zones(None, [], {}, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): simulate_zones(self.zones, None, self.targets, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): simulate_zones(self.zones, [], [], 0)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): simulate_zones(self.zones, [], self.targets, True)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): simulate_zones([[]], [], {}, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): simulate_zones([dict(self.zones[0], temperature="cold")], [], {"a": [0, 1]}, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError): simulate_zones(self.zones, [["a", "b", "x"]], self.targets, 0)

    def test_value_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones(self.zones, self.links, self.targets, -1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones([dict(self.zones[0], extra=1)], [], {"a": [0, 1]}, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones([self.zones[0], dict(self.zones[0])], [], {"a": [0, 1]}, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones([dict(self.zones[0], capacity=0)], [], {"a": [0, 1]}, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones([dict(self.zones[0], temperature=math.inf)], [], {"a": [0, 1]}, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones(self.zones, [["a", "a", 1]], self.targets, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones(self.zones, [["a", "missing", 1]], self.targets, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones(self.zones, [["a", "b", -1]], self.targets, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones(self.zones, [["a", "b", 1], ["b", "a", 2]], self.targets, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones(self.zones, [], {"a": [0, 1]}, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones(self.zones, [], {**self.targets, "x": [0, 1]}, 0)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): simulate_zones(self.zones, [], {"a": [2, 1], "b": [0, 1]}, 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
